name: Courtyard by Marriott Phuket Town
short_description: A select-service Courtyard hotel in the heart of Old Phuket Town, blending traditional Thai design with modern amenities near local markets and heritage architecture.
ai_summary: Courtyard by Marriott Phuket Town is an inland, select-service hotel in Old Phuket Town's Talat Yai district, designed around traditional Thai arts and crafts contrasted with modern amenities, and positioned for travelers who want to be based in the island's cultural and culinary center rather than on a beach. It's rated 4 of 5 across roughly 330 TripAdvisor reviews, a smaller review base than the island's beach resorts reflecting its more recent opening and non-beachfront positioning. Guests consistently describe rooms as cozy, spacious, and clean, praise a varied and delicious breakfast, and specifically call out the Cantonese dim sum lunch at the hotel's Yue Restaurant & Bar as authentic and fresh. One repeat Marriott Titanium Elite guest described the staff as uniformly professional and genuinely committed to service quality. Its location is a short walk or ride to Old Town's markets, heritage shophouses, and restaurants, at around 33 km from the airport. The main trade-off versus this directory's beach resorts is the obvious one: there's no beach access on-site, and amenities are more limited (four restaurants, one pool, a fitness center) in keeping with the select-service Courtyard brand tier.

faqs.question: Does Courtyard by Marriott Phuket Town have beach access?
faqs.answer: No -- it's located inland in Old Phuket Town, about 33 km from the airport, and is best suited to travelers who want to be based near Old Town's markets, heritage architecture, and restaurants rather than directly on a beach.

faqs.question: What is the dining like at Courtyard by Marriott Phuket Town?
faqs.answer: The hotel has four restaurants including Yue Restaurant & Bar, known for Cantonese dim sum that guest reviews describe as authentic and fresh, plus Krua Talad Yai for Thai and international dishes and the Talung Lounge overlooking the Phuket Clock Tower.

reviews.title: Hotel Review by Nath Perrier: Courtyard by Marriott Phuket Town
reviews.author: Nathalie Perrier
reviews.summary: Family-focused stay review praising the strategic Old Town location, spacious Family Room with kitchen, the Kolae pool bar and kids' area, a strong Western/Thai breakfast buffet and attentive staff.

reviews.title: Review: Courtyard By Marriott Hotel Phuket Town (Phuket, Thailand)
reviews.author: Dania
reviews.summary: Three-night Premium King stay rated 4/5. Clean, modern, spacious room 10-15 min from Old Town, but weak soundproofing and average breakfast; standout Cantonese lunch at Yue Restaurant.

reviews.title: Courtyard by Marriott Phuket Town Hotel Review at Phuket Old Town - Deluxe Room
reviews.summary: Local guide reviews the rebranded former Metropole opposite the Clock Tower, highlighting bright white Deluxe rooms, a stylish 4th-floor pool, afternoon tea and a highly recommended breakfast buffet.

reviews.title: Hotel Review: Courtyard by Marriott, Old Town Phuket
reviews.author: Dhairya Sathvara
reviews.summary: Candid 3.5/5 review: quick check-in, attentive staff, comfortable sea-view rooms and sustainable touches, but disappointing on-site food led the writer to eat at local restaurants nearby.
